description: Required/optional field schema for Nigerian photography/videography SMEs.

required_fields.label: Event Type
clarifying_question_templates: What kind of shoot or event is this for?

required_fields.label: Event Date
clarifying_question_templates: What date is the shoot or event?

required_fields.label: Venue / Location
clarifying_question_templates: Where will the shoot take place?

required_fields.label: Coverage Duration (Hours)
clarifying_question_templates: How many hours of coverage do you need?

optional_fields.label: Videography Needed
clarifying_question_templates: Should we include video coverage as well?

optional_fields.label: Editing Turnaround
clarifying_question_templates: How soon do you need the edited photos delivered?

field_completeness_rules.notes: All required fields must be present before a quote can be computed.

ambiguity_handling.note: Treat vague coverage duration as missing.
